newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey, Iran to discuss oil pipeline project.
newsitem.headline: Turkey, Iran to discuss oil pipeline project.

text.p: Turkey and Iran will discuss on Thursday details of a preliminary study for a pipeline to carry Iranian oil to Western markets through Turkey's southern oil terminal of Ceyhan, a senior Turkish official said.

"A study to last six months was offered in ministerial talks and details will be discussed during today's visit by the Iranian president and his oil minister," the official, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters.
Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani arrived in Ankara on Thursday for a four-day visit.

Rafsanjani is accompanied by Oil Minister Gholamreza Aghazadeh, Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati and several other senior officials and will have talks with Turkish officials on various political and economic issues between the two neighbouring countries.
The official said the route of the pipeline had not been discussed but it would end up at the Ceyhan oil terminal, terminus of a twin oil pipeline from Iraq.
